question: __________ has become the 100th 'Har Ghar Jal' district in February 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chamba.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 'Har Ghar Jal' is a government initiative aimed at providing piped water supply to every household in India by 2024.**
 
• ** Chamba, located in Himachal Pradesh, has become the 100th district to achieve the goal of providing a piped water supply to every household in February 2022.**
 
• Kachchh, located in Gujarat, is a district that has been severely affected by earthquakes and has faced water scarcity issues in the past. However, it is not the correct answer to the question.
 
• Mewat, located in Haryana, is a district that has been facing water scarcity and quality issues. However, it is not the correct answer to the question.
 
• Kurnool, located in Andhra Pradesh, is a district that has been facing drought and water scarcity issues. However, it is not the correct answer to the question.
 
• Hence, the statement "Chamba has become the 100th 'Har Ghar Jal' district in February 2022" is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Nal se Jal)

 
 
• Launched in 2019.
 
• Aim: To provide every single rural household with functional household tap connections (FHTC) ‘Har Ghar Nal Se Jal’ by 2024.
 
• A decentralized approach is implemented at national, state, and district levels for specific needs and purposes (Targeted Area approach).
 
• The major role played by Paani Samitis and women in mobilizing the population.
 
• The Jal Jeevan Mission will be based on a community approach to water and will include extensive Information, Education, and communication as a key component of the mission
